capabilities: Apply gradient colors to headings, bold, italic, wikilinks, external links, and normal text
Choose from five preset palettes or pick custom colors with HEX/RGB/HSL inputs
Toggle all gradients globally or per element via commands and settings
Fall back to native theme colors when gradients are disabled
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to give text elements gradient colors, which normally requires hand-written CSS snippets.
summary: Text styling plugin that applies gradient colors to headings, bold, italic, links, and body text via preset palettes or custom pickers.
